# Local PII redaction dependency

This directory contains a browser ESM bundle of
[flare-redact](https://github.com/flare-collection/flare-redact) v1.6.1,
distributed under the MIT license in `flare-redact-LICENSE.txt`.
It is bundled from the exact npm version by esbuild 0.25.12 and
served from this GitHub Pages repository. No third-party scripts,
external network requests or online PII processing are required
to redact user feedback at submission time.
